wording: evidence mapped to the control; never compliant, certified or secure

status_rules.MET BY EVIDENCE: every required evidence kind has a verifying receipt, the row has no known gap attached, and the quote was verified against a PRIMARY source text
status_rules.PARTIAL: at least one required evidence kind has a verifying receipt, but another required kind is absent, a known gap is attached, or the source is secondary
status_rules.GAP: no required evidence kind has a verifying receipt, or a known gap directly contradicts the clause

evidence_kinds.crypto_inventory: CycloneDX CBOM of the TLS posture of our own hosts, with a verifying receipt of its hash
evidence_kinds.log_tamper_detection: a COPY of a ledger with one byte changed fails offline verification while the original passes, with a verifying receipt
evidence_kinds.signed_records: ledger events are signed with ML-DSA-65 and the signed chain verifies offline, with a verifying receipt
evidence_kinds.separate_storage: recorded facts about where each ledger and witness is stored, with a verifying receipt
evidence_kinds.crypto_policy_document: a written cryptographic policy document (process; not provable by E1)
evidence_kinds.key_lifecycle_evidence: records of key generation, renewal, storage, revocation, destruction (not produced by E1)
evidence_kinds.access_control_on_logs: evidence that individuals cannot modify audit logs (not produced by E1)
evidence_kinds.alerting_on_change: alerts raised when audit data changes (not produced by E1)
evidence_kinds.annual_review_record: a record of a review of cryptographic suites at least every 12 months (process; not produced by E1)
evidence_kinds.retention_evidence: evidence that logs are retained for the required period (not produced by E1)
evidence_kinds.audit_review_process: a process that reviews audit records (process; not produced by E1)
evidence_kinds.integrity_policy_document: policies to protect data from improper alteration (process; not produced by E1)
evidence_kinds.distinct_signing_keys: each ledger or actor signs with its own key (contradicted today, see ledgers_share_one_key)
